articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Can PDD (PDD) Turn Its Billion-Dollar Supermarket Bet Into Lasting Competitive Advantage?. PDD Holdings recently began internal beta testing of its “Billion-Dollar Supermarket” grocery service within its app, using heavy subsidies and time-limited coupons to attract price-sensitive users and counter intense competition from JD.com, Alibaba, and Meituan. This move marks a push deeper into everyday essentials, potentially increasing user stickiness at a time when the broader China internet sector faces rising regulatory scrutiny and shifting trade conditions.
